A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we introduce an attention based model that learns the long term and short-term preferences dynamically and adaptively, and the weights of each session item are also learned dynamically.
our method can learn the dynamic weights for items in the same purchase session, and it can dynamically adjust the weights of long term and shrot term preferences.

, we propose a novel sequence aware recommendation method that dynamically balances the long term and short terms preferences, and learns dynamic weights for items in a session to better capture the user's next item to purchase.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a user's long and short term preferences should be treated as separate factors, and that a purchase session should be treated as a whole.
a user's general taste and sequential behavior should be modeled dynamically and the importance of items in a purchase session should be considered.
it is essential to distinguish long term and short terms preferences, and that it is also necessary to weight individual items in a session.
